# Model and source

Kamp et al. (2026) compared oral tacrolimus pharmacokinetics in simultaneous
pancreas-kidney (SPK) and kidney-only (KT) transplant recipients. They reported
three final models, all packaged here:

| Model | Paper label | nlmixr2lib name |
|-------|-------------|-----------------|
| SPK recipients only | model 1 (Table 2, Supplementary Data S1) | `Kamp_2026_tacrolimus_kidneypancreas` |
| KT recipients only | model 2 (Table 2, Supplementary Data S2) | `Kamp_2026_tacrolimus_kidney` |
| SPK + KT pooled, transplant type on Ka | model 3 (Table S3, Supplementary Data S3) | `Kamp_2026_tacrolimus_combined` |

* Citation: `r rxode2::rxode2(readModelDb("Kamp_2026_tacrolimus_combined"))$reference`
* Article: <https://doi.org/10.1007/s40262-026-01689-3> (open access, PMC13623778)

All three share one structure: oral bioavailability fixed at 0.23 (with
between-subject variability), an absorption lag time, first-order absorption
and two-compartment disposition with linear elimination. Because F is fixed
and applied to the dose, CL, Vc, Q and Vp are systemic rather than apparent
(/F) values.

# Population

The data are from a retrospective single-centre cohort at Leiden University
Medical Center, transplanted 2005-2020 and on tacrolimus / mycophenolate /
prednisolone triple therapy with twice-daily immediate-release tacrolimus
(Kamp 2026 Table 1). The 85 SPK recipients (55 male / 30 female; median age
45 years, range 24-56; median weight 73 kg, range 44-104) contributed 1275
whole-blood samples and 76 of them had type 1 diabetes. The 94 KT recipients
(54 male / 40 female; median age 44 years, range 19-76; median weight 68 kg,
range 40-95) contributed 1073 samples and 4 had type 1 diabetes. Samples were
a C0 from about day 4, a 7-point AUC (0-6 h) at week 1 and abbreviated 4-point
AUCs (0-3 h) at 6 weeks, 6 months and 1 year. The per-model metadata are in
`readModelDb("<name>")()$population`.

# Source trace

Every `ini()` value carries an in-file comment naming its source. The
control streams in the supplement hold the final estimates (their `$THETA`
values agree with Table 2 and Table S3 to the printed rounding, and their
`$OMEGA` variances reproduce the tabulated CVs through
CV = sqrt(exp(omega^2) - 1)); they are the only source for the IIV
covariances.

| Parameter | SPK (model 1) | KT (model 2) | Combined (model 3) | Source |
|-----------|---------------|--------------|--------------------|--------|
| F (`lfdepot`, held at its literature value) | 0.23 | 0.23 | 0.23 | Table 2 / Table S3; `THETA(1) 0.23 FIX` |
| Lag time (h) (`ltlag`) | 0.766 | 0.533 | 0.546 | Table 2 / Table S3 (0.77 / 0.53 / 0.55); `THETA(7)` |
| Ka (1/h) (`lka`) | 0.231 | 0.336 | 0.360 (KT) | Table 2 / Table S3 |
| Ka SPK effect (`e_tx_kidney_pancreas_ka`) | - | - | -0.423 | Table S3 'Ka - SPK' 42.3%; S3 `THETA(9)` |
| CL (L/h) (`lcl`) | 6.28 | 5.35 | 5.8 | Table 2 / Table S3 |
| Vc (L) (`lvc`) | 10.9 | 11.8 | 14.0 | Table 2 / Table S3 |
| Q (L/h) (`lq`) | 20.1 | 14.9 | 16.0 | Table 2 / Table S3 |
| Vp (L) (`lvp`) | 125 | 177 | 154 | Table 2 / Table S3 |
| omega^2 F (`etalfdepot`) | 0.209 | 0.252 | 0.231 | `$OMEGA`; CV 48.2 / 53.5 / 51.0% |
| omega^2 Ka, Vc, CL block | 0.556; 0.161, 0.913; 0.0407, 0.155, 0.0272 | 0.378; 0.2, 1.12; 0.0994, 0.133, 0.0547 | 0.46; 0.163, 0.914; 0.0738, 0.124, 0.0414 | `$OMEGA BLOCK(3)` |
| Proportional error (`propSd`) | 0.162 | 0.162 | 0.156 | Table 2 / Table S3; `THETA(8)` |
| Ka covariate equation | - | - | KA = TVKA (1 + theta_SPK) | Methods eq. 2; S3 `$PK` |
| Two-compartment ADVAN4 with ALAG1 and F1 on the depot | all | all | all | Supplementary Data S1-S3 |

# Replicating the paper's simulation

The paper simulated 500 subjects per model on 5 mg twice daily, sampled every
0.1 h, and computed the AUC0-12h of the first dosing interval of day 4
(72-84 h) and its ratio to the C0 of that interval (the pre-dose
concentration at 72 h). The simulations used models 1 and 2. Here 200 subjects
per model are simulated without residual error (the reported AUC/C0 range is
too narrow to include a 16% proportional error on C0).

```{r cohort}
rxode2::rxSetSeed(20261118)
n_per_arm <- 200L

make_cohort <- function(n, id_offset, tx_kidney_pancreas) {
  doses <- tibble(time = seq(0, 72, by = 12), evid = 1L, amt = 5, cmt = "depot")
  obs <- tibble(
    time = sort(unique(c(seq(0, 72, by = 1), seq(72, 84, by = 0.1)))),
    evid = 0L, amt = 0, cmt = "central"
  )
  one <- bind_rows(doses, obs) |> arrange(time, desc(evid))
  tidyr::crossing(id = id_offset + seq_len(n), one) |>
    mutate(TX_KIDNEY_PANCREAS = tx_kidney_pancreas) |>
    arrange(id, time, desc(evid))
}

ev_spk <- make_cohort(n_per_arm, 0L, 1L)
ev_kt <- make_cohort(n_per_arm, n_per_arm, 0L)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(unique(bind_rows(ev_spk, ev_kt)[, c("id", "time", "evid")])))
```

```{r simulate}
mod_spk <- readModelDb("Kamp_2026_tacrolimus_kidneypancreas")
mod_kt <- readModelDb("Kamp_2026_tacrolimus_kidney")
mod_comb <- readModelDb("Kamp_2026_tacrolimus_combined")

sim_sep <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(mod_spk, events = ev_spk)) |> mutate(cohort = "SPK"),
  as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(mod_kt, events = ev_kt)) |> mutate(cohort = "KT")
) |>
  select(id, time, Cc, cohort)
```

## Figure S4: typical concentration-time profiles

```{r figure-s4}
# Replicates Supplemental Figure S4 of Kamp 2026 (PRED profiles, 5 mg BID,
# models 1 and 2); the combined model's typical profiles are overlaid.
typ_ev <- function(tx) make_cohort(1L, 0L, tx) |> filter(time <= 84)
typ <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(rxode2::zeroRe(mod_spk), events = typ_ev(1L))) |>
    mutate(cohort = "SPK", model = "Separate models (1 and 2)"),
  as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(rxode2::zeroRe(mod_kt), events = typ_ev(0L))) |>
    mutate(cohort = "KT", model = "Separate models (1 and 2)"),
  as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(rxode2::zeroRe(mod_comb), events = typ_ev(1L))) |>
    mutate(cohort = "SPK", model = "Combined model (3)"),
  as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(rxode2::zeroRe(mod_comb), events = typ_ev(0L))) |>
    mutate(cohort = "KT", model = "Combined model (3)")
)

ggplot(typ, aes(time, Cc, colour = cohort, linetype = model)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(KT = "red", SPK = "blue")) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (h)", y = "Tacrolimus whole-blood concentration (ug/L)",
    colour = NULL, linetype = NULL,
    caption = "Replicates Supplemental Figure S4 of Kamp 2026 (5 mg twice daily)."
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

The SPK profile has the lower and slightly later peak; after the first few
doses the two populations differ little in trough, which is what drives the
lower AUC0-12h / C0 ratio in SPK recipients.

## Day-4 exposure by population

```{r vpc-day4}
sim_sep |>
  filter(time >= 72) |>
  group_by(cohort, time) |>
  summarise(
    q05 = quantile(Cc, 0.05), q50 = median(Cc), q95 = quantile(Cc, 0.95),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time - 72, q50, colour = cohort, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(KT = "red", SPK = "blue")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(KT = "red", SPK = "blue")) +
  labs(
    x = "Time after the first day-4 dose (h)",
    y = "Tacrolimus whole-blood concentration (ug/L)",
    colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
    caption = "Median and 5th-95th percentiles, 200 subjects per model."
  )
```

# PKNCA validation

```{r pknca}
nca_conc <- sim_sep |>
  filter(!is.na(Cc)) |>
  select(id, time, Cc, cohort)

nca_dose <- bind_rows(
  ev_spk |> mutate(cohort = "SPK"),
  ev_kt |> mutate(cohort = "KT")
) |>
  filter(evid == 1) |>
  select(id, time, amt, cohort)

conc_obj <- PKNCA::PKNCAconc(nca_conc, Cc ~ time | cohort + id)
dose_obj <- PKNCA::PKNCAdose(nca_dose, amt ~ time | cohort + id)
intervals <- data.frame(start = 72, end = 84, auclast = TRUE, cmax = TRUE, tmax = TRUE)
nca_res <- PKNCA::pk.nca(PKNCA::PKNCAdata(conc_obj, dose_obj, intervals = intervals))

auc <- as.data.frame(nca_res) |>
  filter(PPTESTCD == "auclast") |>
  select(cohort, id, auc = PPORRES)
c0 <- sim_sep |>
  filter(time == 72) |>
  select(cohort, id, c0 = Cc)
ratio <- inner_join(auc, c0, by = c("cohort", "id")) |>
  mutate(ratio = auc / c0)
stopifnot(nrow(ratio) == 2 * n_per_arm)
```

```{r nca-compare}
published <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cohort, ~auclast, ~auclast_min, ~auclast_max, ~ratio, ~ratio_min, ~ratio_max,
  "SPK", 172.62, 49.23, 788.79, 15.55, 13.15, 19.31,
  "KT", 191.37, 33.64, 783.09, 17.50, 13.43, 22.49
)

cmp <- nlmixr2lib::ncaComparisonTable(
  simulated = nca_res,
  reference = published |> select(cohort, auclast),
  by = "cohort",
  units = c(auclast = "ug*h/L"),
  tolerance_pct = 20
)
knitr::kable(
  cmp,
  caption = "Day-4 AUC0-12h (72-84 h), simulated median vs Kamp 2026 Results. * differs by >20%."
)

ratio_summary <- ratio |>
  group_by(cohort) |>
  summarise(
    sim_median = median(ratio), sim_min = min(ratio), sim_max = max(ratio),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  inner_join(published |> select(cohort, ratio, ratio_min, ratio_max), by = "cohort")

ratio_summary |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    "Population" = cohort,
    "Simulated median" = sim_median,
    "Simulated min" = sim_min,
    "Simulated max" = sim_max,
    "Published median" = ratio,
    "Published min" = ratio_min,
    "Published max" = ratio_max
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "AUC0-12h / C0 ratio on day 4 (Kamp 2026 Results).")
```

The paper compared the ratios with a gamma GLM (log link) and reported an SPK
effect of 0.90 (95% CI 0.889-0.912) relative to KT (Table S4).

```{r glm}
fit <- glm(ratio ~ cohort, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
           data = ratio |> mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("KT", "SPK"))))
glm_effect <- unname(exp(coef(fit)["cohortSPK"]))
glm_kt <- unname(exp(coef(fit)["(Intercept)"]))
c(KT_ratio = glm_kt, SPK_effect = glm_effect)

auc_med <- auc |> group_by(cohort) |> summarise(m = median(auc), .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(published, by = "cohort")
stopifnot(
  # Medians of a lognormal-like AUC over 200 subjects: Monte-Carlo SE about 5%.
  all(abs(auc_med$m / auc_med$auclast - 1) < 0.15),
  # The ratio distribution is narrow (CV about 10%), so its median is tight.
  all(abs(ratio_summary$sim_median / ratio_summary$ratio - 1) < 0.05),
  abs(glm_kt / 17.37 - 1) < 0.05,
  abs(glm_effect - 0.90) < 0.04
)
```

## Combined model: effect of transplant type

The combined model attributes the whole SPK/KT difference to Ka. Its typical
Ka is 0.360 1/h for KT and 0.360 x (1 - 0.423) = 0.208 1/h for SPK.

```{r combined}
ev_comb <- bind_rows(make_cohort(n_per_arm, 0L, 1L), make_cohort(n_per_arm, n_per_arm, 0L))
sim_comb <- as.data.frame(rxode2::rxSolve(mod_comb, events = ev_comb, keep = "TX_KIDNEY_PANCREAS")) |>
  mutate(cohort = ifelse(TX_KIDNEY_PANCREAS == 1, "SPK", "KT"))
comb_ratio <- sim_comb |>
  filter(time >= 72) |>
  group_by(cohort, id) |>
  summarise(
    auc = sum(diff(time) * (head(Cc, -1) + tail(Cc, -1)) / 2),
    c0 = Cc[time == 72],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(ratio = auc / c0)
comb_ratio |>
  group_by(cohort) |>
  summarise(median_auc = median(auc), median_ratio = median(ratio), .groups = "drop") |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2, caption = "Combined model, day-4 AUC0-12h (ug*h/L) and AUC0-12h / C0 ratio.")
```

# Assumptions and deviations

- **Combined-model Ka.** Supplemental Table S3 gives Ka = 0.360 1/h (RSE 10%,
  bootstrap median 0.361, 95% CI 0.308-0.513) for the KT reference group;
  the `$THETA` record of Supplementary Data S3 prints 0.336, which is the KT
  model's own estimate. Every other `$THETA` in that control stream equals
  Table S3, so 0.336 looks like a value carried over from the KT model's
  stream, and the bootstrap median supports 0.360. The table value is used.
- **Precision.** Where the control stream carries more digits than the table
  (lag times 0.766, 0.533 and 0.546 h vs 0.77, 0.53 and 0.55 h) the control
  stream values are used; they round to the table values.
- **Bioavailability variability.** NONMEM's `F1 = 0.23 * exp(ETA(1))` is
  unbounded above, and so is the packaged `exp(lfdepot + etalfdepot)`. With
  a 48-54% CV, fewer than 0.1% of simulated subjects exceed F = 1.
- **Occasions.** The authors entered each sampling occasion as a separate ID
  instead of estimating inter-occasion variability, so the IIV here also
  absorbs occasion-to-occasion variability.
- **Residual error in the simulation.** The reproduction of the day-4
  AUC0-12h / C0 ratio uses the model predictions without residual error; with
  a 16% proportional error on C0, the ratio range would be far wider than the
  13-22 the paper reports.
- **Covariates screened but not retained.** Time after transplantation (0-6,
  6-26 and > 26 weeks) on Ka and on lag time was not retained in either
  separate model (Tables S1 and S2) and is listed in
  `covariatesDataExcluded`.
- **Transplant-type covariate.** The control stream's `NPTX` (1 = SPK) is the
  column `TX_KIDNEY_PANCREAS` here (1 = simultaneous pancreas-kidney,
  0 = kidney only).
- No erratum or correction notice was listed for this article in Europe PMC
  as of 2026-11-18.
